settings.text: Find answers to common questions or get in touch with our team.

settings.heading: How long does it take to build a bamboo bicycle?
settings.row_content: At a workshop: 2-3 days with expert guidance. At home: 20-40 hours spread over several weeks, depending on your experience and the complexity of your build.

settings.heading: Is the frame strong enough for everyday use?
settings.row_content: Yes! Bamboo has an excellent strength-to-weight ratio, comparable to steel. Our frames are designed for regular cycling and have been ridden thousands of kilometres by our community.

settings.heading: What's included in the home build kits?
settings.row_content: Our kits include all bamboo tubes (heat-treated and sized), lugs (head tube, bottom bracket, seat tube, dropouts), binding materials, epoxy resins, and detailed instructions. Tools are not included but we sell tool kits separately.

settings.heading: Do you ship internationally?
settings.row_content: Yes! We've shipped to over 36 countries. International shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location. Please note that customs duties may apply in some countries.

settings.heading: Can I use the Cycle to Work scheme?
settings.row_content: Yes, our kits and workshops are eligible for most Cycle to Work schemes including Cyclescheme, Cycle Solutions, Evans, and Halfords. Contact us for a quote or certificate letter.

settings.heading: What if I have problems during my build?
settings.row_content: We offer ongoing support through our community forum, video tutorials, and email support. Most build questions can be answered within 24 hours. For complex issues, we can arrange a video call.
